TOKEN POOL ISSUE IDENTIFIED AND FIXED:

PROBLEM: Generic Orchestrator designed for parallel execution but token deduplication was preventing parallel execution with single API key.

ROOT CAUSE: TokenLoader was deduplicating identical tokens (line 61: `tokens = list(dict.fromkeys(tokens))`), so multiple instances of same Claude API token were reduced to single token, forcing sequential execution.

SOLUTION: Removed deduplication logic to allow same token multiple times for parallel execution. Same Claude API key can handle multiple concurrent requests.

FIX APPLIED:
- Modified token_loader.py to preserve duplicate tokens
- Set CLAUDE_CODE_TOKENS environment variable with multiple token instances  
- Confirmed orchestrator now gets 7 tokens from token pool
- Parallel execution restored: can run 3 agents simultaneously

VALIDATION:
- Before fix: 1 token, sequential execution only
- After fix: 7 tokens, 3 parallel agents confirmed
- Generic
